content: Our experiments aim to measure if the incorporation of subword information into LexVec results in similar improvements as observed in moving from Skip-gram to fastText, and whether unsupervised morphemes offer any advantage over n-grams. For IV words, we perform intrinsic evaluation via word similarity and word analogy tasks, as well as downstream tasks. OOV word representation is tested through qualitative nearest-neighbor analysis.
